resources.string: An AI assistant that lives on your phone
Chat, summarize PDFs, ask questions about documents and translate — all powered by a language model running on this phone.
No account. No cloud. No analytics. Your chats never leave this phone. The only internet use is the one-time model download.
Your phone has %1$d GB of RAM. We recommend %2$s (%3$s). You can download it on Wi-Fi in the next step.
You will choose a model in the next step. Models are between 0.6 and 2.6 GB.
Small on-device models make mistakes and can sound confident when they are wrong. Check important facts, and do not rely on PocketMind for medical, legal or financial decisions.
